title: Faceless & Not Anonymous Workbook

content_summary: Companion workbook to a 'Faceless & Not Anonymous' course, with one page per module, built on the idea 'people trust what they can check' ('Start here' callout). Module 1 separates faceless ('you choose not to show your face') from anonymous ('nobody can tell who is responsible') and notes when faceless is harder (one-to-one personality services, coaching, in-home local services, regulated work). Module 2 is a five-layer trust stack (Name, Contact, Policies, Pages, Replies) scored 0-2, with templates for a plain-words refund policy and a founder contact block. Modules 3-4 cover recognisable look/voice/signature and 'proof without hype' (remove-the-hype checklist, FACT/EST/UNKNOWN labelling table, a one-time review request). Modules 5-6 give boundaries, a founder note and three replies to 'who's behind this?', an AI/helper disclosure checklist, a 14-item trust audit scored out of 28, an ask-a-friend script and a three-monthly re-audit schedule.

Closes with a messaging-window table, a 'what not to do' list, spam-law pointers by country, a testing checklist, troubleshooting and a weekly tracker with no targets.
